name: Aelnir Battery Charge Alarm
seoTitle: Aelnir Battery Charge Alarm: charge level alerts for Android
summary: Alerts at the charge levels you choose, on low battery and when the charger is unplugged, with charge-session history.
tagline: Stop overcharging and never miss a low battery. A reliable alarm for 80%, 90%, full, low and unplugged, with no account.

features.title: Alerts you can rely on
features.lead: Monitoring runs on your phone and keeps working after a restart.

items.title: Charge alerts
items.body: Alerts at 80%, 90% and 100%, or at a custom level, plus a full-battery alert.

items.title: Low battery and unplugged
items.body: Warns on low battery and when the charger is disconnected, with debouncing so it does not cry wolf.

items.title: High temperature
items.body: An alert if the battery stays hot, so you can unplug before it matters.

items.title: In control
items.body: Snooze, dismiss, or stop for tonight. Quiet hours post and log alerts but keep them silent.

items.title: Charge history
items.body: See each charging session on a chart, with an estimate of when it will be full.

items.title: Reliability checklist
items.body: Guided tips for phone makers that stop background apps, and a self-test to check alerts really fire.

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Ads never touch an alert
note.body: Aelnir Battery Charge Alarm is free and supported by ads, which never appear in notifications or on the alarm screen. A one-time Remove Ads purchase is available. Your battery history stays on your phone.

privacy.headline: Your battery history stays on your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. Battery readings and charge history are kept on your device. The free app shows ads through Google AdMob, whose SDK collects limited device and usage data, never your battery history.

studioProof.hard: A pure alert engine fed only by time ticks and battery readings, with a watchdog that restarts monitoring and says so if it cannot.
